decks.notes: This deck focuses on controlling the game through a mix of removal spells, countermagic, and disruptive creatures. The key strategy is to use cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to disrupt the opponent's game plan while ramping into powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Emrakul, the Promised End. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents and generating card advantage. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth color fixing and access to powerful utility lands.

The deck focuses on quickly playing efficient threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Counterspell, Spell Pierce, and Archmage's Charm. The deck aims to establish control of the board early on and maintain pressure through a combination of burn spells like Lightning Bolt and efficient card draw/filtering tools like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble. It also utilizes cards like Ledger Shredder and Dress Down to disrupt opposing strategies and protect its own threats. The deck's mana base is built around a mix of fetch lands and fast mana sources to support its aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on casting cards with high mana cost abilities for cheap or free, while manipulating the graveyard to cascade into the powerful Living End spell. By cycling through creatures like Architects of Will and Striped Riverwinder, the player can fill their graveyard quickly and then cast Living End to bring back all their creatures and potentially wipe out their opponent's board. The deck also has control elements with Force of Negation and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and utilizing a combination of sacrifice and graveyard recursion. It uses cards like Ovalchase Daredevil and Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar to generate card advantage and apply constant pressure. The Underworld Cookbook and Witch's Oven provide an engine for sacrificing creatures and creating food tokens for further benefits. Finale of Devastation allows for the deck to search for key creatures and finish off opponents. Urza's Saga provides additional value with artifact tokens, while the deck also includes a mix of lands to support the strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to ramp up quickly and efficiently, allowing the player to play powerful cards such as Primeval Titan and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove early in the game. By utilizing land tutoring cards like Expedition Map and Tolaria West, the deck aims to assemble the combination of lands needed to generate a strong board state and close out the game with powerful creatures and lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The deck is designed to quickly put pressure on the opponent and overwhelm them with large threats.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent by playing aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing efficient creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, along with powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike, the deck aims to apply pressure early and often. The deck also includes cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel to punish opponents for playing spells, and Boros Charm for versatility and reach. The mana base is optimized for consistent and fast gameplay, ensuring a swift victory through aggressive tactics.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly deploy efficient threats in the form of Eldrazi creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. The deck also utilizes powerful artifacts like Urza's Saga and Karn, the Great Creator to search for additional threats or answer specific threats from the opponent. The overall goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive elements to control the pace of the game and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful equipment combo as quickly as possible to overwhelm the opponent with massive damage in a short amount of time. The key is to use cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Puresteel Paladin, and Sigarda's Aid to quickly get Colossus Hammer onto a creature like Inkmoth Nexus or Kaldra Compleat. With cards like Giver of Runes and Spell Pierce for protection, the deck aims to win the game before the opponent can set up their own strategy. The deck is highly efficient and aggressive, aiming to end the game swiftly.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing powerful cards like Counterspell, Solitude, and Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Endurance to stabilize the board and provide additional utility. The deck benefits from the card advantage provided by Yorion, Sky Nomad and the efficient card selection of Expressive Iteration. Additionally, the deck has strong mana fixing with cards like Abundant Growth and powerful lands like Boseiju, Who Endures, allowing it to consistently cast its spells and control the game effectively.

The deck revolves around using the Amulet of Vigor to untap lands and generate mana quickly, allowing for explosive plays with Primeval Titan and other big creatures like Cultivator Colossus. It also utilizes lands like Urza's Saga and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to generate additional value and win conditions. The main goal is to assemble the Amulet Titan combo as quickly as possible, enabling powerful plays and overwhelming the opponent with a combination of ramp, large creatures, and powerful land interactions.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with Cascade to overwhelm the opponent and generate value from the cards cascaded into. The deck includes a mix of creatures and spells with Cascade, along with disruption spells like Force of Negation to protect the strategy. By utilizing powerful Cascade cards like Shardless Agent and Crashing Footfalls, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain that pressure throughout the game. The mana base is built to support the Cascade spells while providing access to different colors of mana for flexibility in casting spells.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent by cascading into powerful spells like Violent Outburst and Crashing Footfalls. The cascade mechanic allows for additional value by casting additional spells for free. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Negation and versatile cards like Prismari Command to help control the board and push damage through. With a mix of aggressive creatures, removal, and cascade spells, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the game.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana through land cards and utilizing cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Indomitable Creativity, and Archon of Cruelty to create powerful combos and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining various spells and creatures with high synergy and versatility, the player can both control the board and deal significant amounts of damage quickly. The inclusion of cards like Wrenn and Six and Prismari Command provide additional utility and flexibility to adapt to different situations. Overall, this deck is designed to surprise and overwhelm opponents with its creative and explosive plays.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be accessed through Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution. It aims to create value through sacrificing creatures and generating incremental advantage with Blood Artist triggering off sacrifices. Yawgmoth, Thran Physician acts as a central piece in the combo, allowing for card draw and creature removal. The deck's mana base is designed to support the diverse casting costs of the creatures while also providing access to key lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth.

The deck focuses on tutoring for specific creatures to create a powerful combo that generates value through sacrificing and reanimating creatures. The key strategy involves using cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution to search for key pieces like Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. The deck also utilizes creatures with undying or persist abilities to maximize value from sacrificing creatures. The mana base includes a mix of green and black sources to support the combo pieces and ensure consistency in executing the game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing Tameshi Bloom to manipulate the battlefield and achieve a powerful combo. The key strategy involves using cards like Wrenn and Six, Teferi, Time Raveler, and Lotus Bloom to control the board while searching for combo pieces with cards like Eladamri's Call and Wargate. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Cultivator Colossus and Omnath, Locus of Creation to secure victory. By effectively managing resources and timing plays, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its versatile combo potential.

The deck focuses on utilizing lands and mana ramp to quickly assemble the necessary pieces to activate the combo potential of Primeval Titan. By utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck can generate large amounts of mana and search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. The goal is to create a board state where Primeval Titan can attack and fetch lands that will enable a lethal combo finish.

The deck focuses on efficiently ramping into Primeval Titan to search for utility lands or Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle for a combo finish. Amulet of Vigor allows for explosive starts by untapping lands and Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove help accelerate mana production. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga to tutor for key artifacts like Amulet of Vigor. The combination of land ramp, land searching, and combo potential make this deck a powerful force in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to rapidly deal damage to the opponent by utilizing low-cost, efficient cards that can be played quickly. It focuses on creatures with haste and direct damage spells to keep up the pressure and prevent the opponent from stabilizing. The deck aims to be aggressive and proactive, aiming to win the game quickly before the opponent can mount a defense or stabilize. It prioritizes efficiency and speed in its card choices to maximize its chances of winning within the first few turns of the game.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively deal damage quickly to the opponent using low-cost creatures and burn spells. It aims to maintain pressure on the opponent by consistently casting impactful spells and efficiently utilizing resources. The deck focuses on playing powerful red spells, like Lightning Bolt and Boros Charm, to burn the opponent's life total down as quickly as possible. By leveraging its aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, along with burn spells like Lava Spike and Rift Bolt, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and casting cascade spells to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and spells. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can cascade into high-impact spells like Crashing Footfalls to quickly build a board presence. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation to protect its game plan. The combination of aggression and cascading allows the deck to apply pressure and outpace traditional control strategies, making it a formidable force in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards that allow the player to create powerful combos by either transforming their own creatures or generating tokens, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with a unique and unconventional strategy. By combining various spells and cards that can manipulate the battlefield and generate value, the player aims to control the game by outpacing and outsmarting their opponent. The deck thrives on creativity and ingenuity in order to achieve victory through unexpected and powerful interactions.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Death's Shadow and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to quickly bring down the opponent's life total. By combining these threats with disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Drown in the Loch, the deck aims to control the game and maintain tempo advantage. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to dig through the deck and find key pieces. Additionally, Jegantha, the Wellspring is used as a companion to provide a ramp option and add consistency to the deck.

The deck focuses on utilizing the powerful combo potential of Glimpse of Tomorrow to quickly bring out key creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Wavesifter. By cascading into Glimpse of Tomorrow with cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck can flood the board with creatures and potentially overwhelm the opponent in a single turn. The deck also includes cards like Endurance and Subtlety for protection and disruption, ensuring that the combo can go off smoothly. With a mix of ramp, card draw, and control elements, the deck aims to create explosive and game-winning plays.

This deck aims to aggressively disrupt the opponent's strategy while deploying threats to quickly close out the game. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to strip the opponent's hand of key cards, combined with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate, the deck aims to maintain control of the game. Wrenn and Six provide additional card advantage and graveyard recursion, while cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Tarmogoyf provide powerful threats to pressure the opponent. The land base is optimized to support the deck's mana requirements and take advantage of the powerful Urza's Saga.

This deck focuses on quickly cycling through cards to fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures, then casting Living End to bring all those creatures back onto the battlefield for a massive board presence. The combination of cycler creatures, cascade spells, and disruption spells allows the deck to quickly set up its combo and overwhelm the opponent with a sudden flurry of creatures. The deck aims to efficiently control the game until it can execute its game-winning combo, putting pressure on the opponent to keep up with the fast pace of the deck.

This deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy by using hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while also utilizing removal spells such as Fatal Push and Bloodchief's Thirst to control the board. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Archon of Cruelty and Griselbrand to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. Additionally, with cards like Mazemind Tome and Relic of Progenitus, the deck can draw cards and disrupt the opponent's graveyard strategies. By taking advantage of the mono black control archetype, this deck aims to dominate the game through resource management and powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm opponents quickly with a swarm of small, artifact creatures such as Ornithopter and Memnite. The deck aims to utilize artifacts synergies and cards like Cranial Plating and Nettlecyst to enhance the power of these creatures. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for key artifacts like Springleaf Drum and Thoughtcast. The deck also includes some utility artifacts like Aether Spellbomb and Shadowspear for additional support. The aggressive strategy is further supported by mana fixing lands like Darksteel Citadel and Spire of Industry.

This deck focuses on using a mix of counter spells, burn spells, and efficient creatures to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. It aims to control the game early with counterspells like Spell Snare and Archmage's Charm, while also having removal and burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to deal with threats. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help with card selection and advantage, while powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent help close out the game quickly. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap, efficient threats and disruption spells to apply pressure and control the board early in the game. The key strategy is to quickly deploy powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while using countermagic and removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also leverages card selection and advantage through spells like Consider, Expressive Iteration, and Archmage's Charm to stay ahead in resources and maintain a fast tempo throughout the game.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly playing efficient spells to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck includes a mix of counterspells, burn spells, card draw, and threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help maintain card advantage while powerful land cards like Otawara, Soaring City and Fiery Islet provide utility. The goal is to apply pressure early, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and close out the game before they can stabilize.
